topic: OEIS A391810, formulas (2)--(6), COMMENTS (C.1)--(C.10), and the prime-zero clause of (C.11)
title: OEIS A391810: formula (5), COMMENTS (C.1)--(C.10), and prime-index vanishing

creators.name: Zhang, Wenlin
creators.affiliation: National University of Singapore; ChronoAI Pte Ltd, Singapore

abstract: We prove formula (5), COMMENTS (C.1)--(C.10), and the zero clause of COMMENT (C.11) of Paul D. Hanna's OEIS entry A391810, revision 39. For n>=1, the original bilateral Laurent coefficients form a finite row polynomial P_n(y)=-1+sum(h=1..n)y^h(1-y^h)^(n-h). Evaluating it at -1 gives the negative alternating row sum 2 round(2^n/3)=2J_n. The same polynomial proves formulas (2), (3), (4), and (6). Its divisor-sum coefficient expression proves the ten individual-term formulas and T(n,q)=0 for every prime q>n. The further first-zero assertion of (C.11) remains open in this note.
summary: Complete written proofs of A391810 formulas (2)--(6), COMMENTS (C.1)--(C.10), and prime-index vanishing, with a divisor formula, exact source-item coverage, and finite checks through row 79. The first-zero assertion in (C.11) remains open here.
